title: Slugify page titles into URL handles
prompt: Implement `slugify(title)` in solution_stub.py for generating URL handles from page titles. Rules: lowercase everything; treat runs of spaces, tabs, newlines, underscores, and hyphens as a SINGLE separator; drop every other non-alphanumeric character; join words with single hyphens; no leading or trailing hyphens. If nothing survives (empty or punctuation-only input), return "untitled". The current version only lowercases and swaps spaces for hyphens, so punctuation leaks into handles and empty titles produce empty slugs.
